request: Order ORD-1001 hasn't shipped yet. Investigate why and what we should do.

steps.text: I’m pulling the order details to confirm fulfillment status, promised date, warehouse, and line items so I can decide whether to check inventory.
I’m checking stock for each ordered SKU at the order’s warehouse to see if insufficient inventory is preventing fulfillment.
I’m searching other warehouses for at least 38 units of SKU-202 to see if a single-site transfer can cover the shortfall.
I’m submitting my findings with evidence and a recommended next step.

arguments.summary: ORD-1001 has not shipped because the assigned warehouse (WH-BOS) lacks sufficient stock for SKU-202 (12 available vs 50 ordered). Alternative stock at WH-CHI can cover the 38-unit shortfall.
evidence: get_order_details: ORD-1001 fulfillment_status PENDING_FULFILLMENT; fulfillment_warehouse_id WH-BOS; promised_delivery_date 2026-03-19; is_past_promised_date false; items SKU-202 quantity 50.
check_inventory: SKU-202 at WH-BOS on_hand 12, reserved 0, available 12.

find_alternative_stock: SKU-202 required_quantity 38 excluding WH-BOS; WH-CHI available 80 can_cover_required_quantity true; WH-ATL available 30 can_cover_required_quantity false; WH-DAL available 0 can_cover_required_quantity false; warehouses_with_sufficient_stock ["WH-CHI"].
arguments.likely_cause: Insufficient inventory at WH-BOS for SKU-202.
uncertainties: Whether an inter-warehouse transfer from WH-CHI can arrive and be processed before the 2026-03-19 promised date.
arguments.recommendation: Request an immediate transfer of 38 units of SKU-202 from WH-CHI to WH-BOS to cover the shortfall and ship upon receipt.
